title: feat(cli): OTLP resource carries service.instance.id under declared replicas
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9X9x1UU3gnCVbaRzaTCNw4o)_

Fixes #31930

Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured: on base `c9246279` a boot with `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true` + `OS_CLUSTER_DRIVER=redis` exports the resource `service.name`, `deployment.environment` (the literal at `serve.ts:285-288`); on this head the same boot exports those two plus `service.instance.id`. An undeclared boot exports the same two attributes, in the same order, on both. Nothing is narrowed: no variable, key or route is added or refused.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os serve` 用 OTLP 导出指标时，若声明了多副本（`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS>1` 或 `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`）且集群驱动是 redis，resource 多带一个 `service.instance.id`，值为 `主机名-pid`（k8s 上主机名即 pod 名；主机名取不到时用随机 id）。
- 为什么改：今天每个副本导出完全相同的 resource，指标后端把所有副本并成一条序列，看不出哪个副本出问题（cloud#3814 N5）。
- 风险与回滚：只在上述声明下生效，单节点和其他驱动的 resource 逐字节不变；不新增环境变量，不碰 split-brain 守卫。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`（`serveInstanceId` 与 `serveOtlpResource`，以及 `buildServeObservability` 里改为调用它的一行）；`packages/cli/src/commands/serve-otlp-service-instance-id.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/serve-otlp-service-instance-id.test.ts`，预期 11/11 通过（同主机两副本 id 不同，未声明的 resource 与今天逐字节相同）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`serveOtlpResource(env)`** (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`) builds the resource the OTLP exporter in `buildServeObservability` is constructed with. It always carries `service.name` and `deployment.environment` as before, and adds `service.instance.id` only under `declaresReplicasSharingState(env)`: the CLI's existing pre-boot form of the cluster package's `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis` (cloud#3814 R3), already imported by `serve.ts` and already asked before boot by the local-database refusal. No second reading of the declaration is written.
- **`serveInstanceId()`** is `HOSTNAME-PID`. The host name is the pod name on Kubernetes and the container id under Compose; the pid tells apart two replicas that share a host name within one PID namespace (it does not across PID namespaces: a fixed Compose `hostname:` or host-network containers are each pid 1 and export one id, so such replicas need distinct host names) and is stable across a container restart (pid 1), so a restart does not open a new series. A host that reports no name, or throws asking, falls back to `crypto.randomUUID()` for the process. `cluster.nodeId` is not used: it is generated inside the runtime after the exporter is built (the exporter's resource is fixed at construction), and it changes on every restart (seat ruling on step 0).
- **No override variable** (seat ruling). `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` and the OpenTelemetry resource detectors are not read anywhere in the CLI or `@objectstack/observability` (measured: zero `OTEL_` reads in `packages/cli/src`, `packages/observability/src`, `packages/runtime/src`, `packages/core/src`), so there is no operator-written `service.instance.id` this one could override, and no read of it is added.
- **Docs**: one paragraph under the Observability table in `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`, and one line in the env comment block above `buildServeObservability`.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-otlp-service-instance-id.test.ts` (unit tier, 11 cases). Every case asks `serveOtlpResource` from the environment alone; a second process is a second host stand-in (same host name, its own pid).

- Declared (`OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true` and `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=3`, each over redis): two processes on one host get `node-7-101` and `node-7-102`.
- Fallback: an all-blank host name and a throwing one each give that process's random id.
- The default host is this process: `HOSTNAME-PID`.
- CONTROL, byte-identical JSON to today's two-attribute resource: nothing declared; redis without a declaration; `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1` over redis; declared over `memory`; declared with no cluster driver.
- On the wire: a real `OtlpHttpMetricsRegistry` flushed to a local HTTP receiver carries the two distinct ids in `resource.attributes`, and an undeclared boot carries none.

No existing test was changed.

<details><summary>Ablations (three legs, each restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, the test imports it from source (no dist leg needed):

- A1, the attribute on every boot (`if (true || await declaresReplicasSharingState(env))`): 6 failed, all five CONTROL cases plus "an undeclared boot exports no service.instance.id".
- A2, host name only (`return name ? name : host.randomId()`): 4 failed, the two distinct-id cases, the wire case (`expected 'node-7' to be 'node-7-101'`) and the default-host case.
- A3, no fallback (`` return `${name}-${host.pid}` ``): 1 failed, the fallback case (`expected '-101' to be 'random-a'`).

</details>

<details><summary>Two real processes on one host, through the built dist</summary>

Two `node` processes importing `packages/cli/dist/commands/serve.js` and flushing a real `OtlpHttpMetricsRegistry` to one local receiver, then a third with nothing declared:

```
declared A {"service.name":"objectstack","deployment.environment":"production","service.instance.id":"vm-6927"}
declared B {"service.name":"objectstack","deployment.environment":"production","service.instance.id":"vm-6935"}
undeclared {"service.name":"objectstack","deployment.environment":"production"}
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not covered by the declaration, by design (R2/R3): a topology declared over the in-process driver with `OS_ALLOW_MEMORY_CLUSTER_MULTINODE=true`, and any non-redis remote driver (none ships in this repository). Those boots export today's resource.
- The cloud host builds its own resource in its own observability file; this PR does not touch it.

## Verification

All readings on head `4e948efa` (base `c9246279`, `origin/main` unmoved since). They carry over to `359a2538`, which changes wording only (the `serveInstanceId` doc comment, the changeset bullet and the docs paragraph); on `359a2538` the cli typecheck exits 0, the new test is 11/11 and the derived gates are 101/101.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 409 passed (409), Tests 5858 passed (5858); lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The integration tier is left to CI: the diff touches no spawn entry or integration file.
- New file alone: 11 passed (11).
- Package lint: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched `.ts` files, exit 0 (the package has no lint script).
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` named 101; all 101 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles "101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Four exited 3 on the first pass for missing prerequisites (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` needed `turbo run build` over `./packages/**` and `./examples/**`) and exit 0 after them.
